lessons.title: Introduction and syllabus
sections: How leadership develops

Some people bring natural qualities to leadership. People can also learn through challenge, practice and reflection. In Lesson 1, the Hero’s Journey illustrates growth through trials. A task that is too easy can cause boredom; one that is too hard can cause stress.
领导力如何形成
有些人天生具备有助于领导的品质，人也能通过挑战、练习和反思来学习领导。第 1 课用“英雄之旅”说明人如何在考验中成长。任务过易会令人厌倦，过难则可能带来压力。
Leadership as an influence process

Leadership is a process in which an individual influences a group to achieve a common goal. Four elements belong together: process, influence, group and common goal. A volunteer leading a local project can exercise leadership just as a high-profile public figure can.
领导力是一种影响过程
领导力是个人影响群体、促使大家达成共同目标的过程。这里有四个要素：过程、影响、群体和共同目标。带领社区项目的志愿者与广受关注的公众人物一样，都可以发挥领导力。

lessons.title: Understanding leadership
sections: Leadership as an influence process

Leadership is a process in which an individual influences a group to achieve a common goal. Four elements belong together: process, influence, group and common goal. A volunteer leading a local project can exercise leadership just as a high-profile public figure can.
领导力是一种影响过程
领导力是个人影响群体、促使大家达成共同目标的过程。这里有四个要素：过程、影响、群体和共同目标。带领社区项目的志愿者与广受关注的公众人物一样，都可以发挥领导力。
Trait · ability · skill

A trait is a personal quality such as determination. An ability is a capacity that may come naturally or develop through practice. A skill is a competence learned through instruction, practice and feedback. In Kolb’s cycle, experience is followed by reflection, forming an idea and testing it in action.
特质、能力与技能
特质指个人品质，例如果断坚持。能力是做某件事的潜能，可以源于天赋，也可以通过练习发展。技能则是通过指导、练习和反馈习得的本领。在科尔布的学习循环中，人先经历一件事，再反思、形成想法，最后用行动检验想法。
Behaviour · relationship · influence

Behaviour describes what leaders do. Task behaviours organise the work; process behaviours help people feel included. A relationship involves reciprocal influence and shared authority. An influence process brings a group together around a common goal.
行为、关系与影响
行为指领导者实际做了什么。任务行为用来组织工作，过程行为帮助成员感到自己受到接纳。关系涉及双向影响和权力共享。影响过程让一群人围绕共同目标展开行动。
Management and leadership

Management seeks order. Leadership seeks constructive change. Both involve influencing people to achieve a goal. The same team leader may organise an experiment and persuade the group to explore a new research direction.
管理与领导
管理追求有序，领导推动有益的改变。两者都会通过影响他人来实现目标。同一位组长可以安排实验流程，也可以说服全组尝试新的研究方向。

lessons.title: Evolution of leadership approaches
sections: Trait and behavioural approaches
The trait approach studies the qualities leaders possess. The behavioural approach studies what leaders actually do, especially how they organise tasks and work with people.
特质视角与行为视角
特质视角研究领导者具备哪些个人品质。行为视角研究领导者具体做了什么，尤其关注他们怎样组织任务、怎样与成员共事。
Situational approach

Effective leadership depends on the task, the followers and the context. Contingency theory matches a leader’s style to the situation. Path–goal theory considers how a leader can motivate followers and help them reach goals.
情境视角
领导是否有效取决于任务、追随者和所处环境。权变理论强调让领导风格与情境相匹配。路径—目标理论关注领导者如何激励成员并帮助他们实现目标。
Relational approach

Leader–member exchange (LMX) focuses on the quality of the relationship between a leader and each follower. Close relationships may support performance. Favouritism can divide a team into in-groups and out-groups and leave some members feeling excluded.
关系视角
领导者—成员交换理论（LMX）关注领导者与每位成员之间的关系质量。亲近的关系可能有助于提升表现。偏爱少数成员则可能把团队分成圈内人和圈外人，让一部分人感到被排斥。
New leadership approach
Visionary and charismatic leaders can inspire people to pursue change. Transformational leadership explains how the process can change both people and organisations.
新领导力视角
有愿景和感召力的领导者能够鼓舞大家推动改变。变革型领导理论解释了这个过程如何改变个人和组织。
Five contemporary perspectives

Adaptive leadership helps people solve problems and adapt to change. Authentic leadership emphasises self-awareness, honesty and openness to feedback. Spiritual leadership builds meaning, purpose and belonging. Servant leadership supports followers’ growth and autonomy. Gender-based studies examine how gender relates to leadership.
五种当代视角
适应型领导帮助成员解决问题、适应变化。真实型领导重视自我认识、诚实和接纳反馈。精神型领导建立意义感、使命感和归属感。服务型领导支持成员成长和自主。性别研究则探讨性别与领导之间的关系。

lessons.title: King of the Hill: Denny Hill
sections: Evidence from the cases

Denny Hill persevered after failure (determination) and comforted discouraged swimmers (sociability). Worksheet 6 identifies integrity and determination as the two most common traits among its five leaders. Self-confidence concerns belief in one’s own ability; charisma concerns the capacity to inspire other people.
用案例证据识别特质
丹尼·希尔在失败后坚持执教，体现毅力；他安慰失落的游泳队员，体现亲和力。练习 6 指出，五位领导者最常见的两种特质是正直与毅力。自信指相信自己的能力，感召力指能够鼓舞他人。
Trait · ability · skill

A trait is a personal quality such as determination. An ability is a capacity that may come naturally or develop through practice. A skill is a competence learned through instruction, practice and feedback. In Kolb’s cycle, experience is followed by reflection, forming an idea and testing it in action.
特质、能力与技能
特质指个人品质，例如果断坚持。能力是做某件事的潜能，可以源于天赋，也可以通过练习发展。技能则是通过指导、练习和反馈习得的本领。在科尔布的学习循环中，人先经历一件事，再反思、形成想法，最后用行动检验想法。

lessons.title: Developing leadership traits
sections: Intelligence · Self-confidence

Intelligence involves understanding information, reasoning through problems and expressing ideas clearly. Build general intelligence by becoming well informed about the work. Self-confidence is belief in one’s ability to do a task. A mentor, feedback and progressively more demanding roles can build it.
智力与自信
智力包括理解信息、推理解决问题和清楚表达想法。深入了解工作有助于提升实际判断能力。自信是相信自己能完成任务。导师指导、反馈以及逐步承担更有挑战的角色都能增强自信。
Charisma

Charisma is the ability to attract and inspire followers. Five behaviours support it: model the values you advocate, show competence, communicate clear goals and strong values, set high expectations and express confidence in followers, and inspire others.
感召力
感召力是吸引并鼓舞追随者的能力。五种做法有助于培养它：以身作则践行价值观，展现胜任力，清楚表达目标和价值观，对成员抱有高期望并表达信任，以及鼓舞他人行动。
Determination · Sociability

Determination is the drive to pursue goals despite setbacks. Determined leaders stay focused, clarify goals, articulate a vision and encourage others to persevere. Sociability means being approachable, tactful and sensitive to others’ needs. It can be practised by being friendly, kind, open and supportive.
毅力与亲和力
毅力使人即使遭遇挫折也能继续追求目标。坚定的领导者保持专注、明确目标、描述愿景，并鼓励他人坚持。亲和力体现为容易接近、待人得体、体察需求。友善、开放、支持他人都是可以练习的行为。
Integrity

Integrity combines honesty, trustworthiness and consistency between principles and actions. When integrity is questioned, a leader loses influence. Being honest also requires judgement about what is appropriate to disclose.
正直与诚信
正直包括诚实、值得信任，以及言行符合原则。诚信受到质疑时，领导者会失去影响力。诚实也需要判断哪些信息适合披露。

lessons.title: Core leadership skills
sections: Administrative skills

Managing people means staying in contact with staff, understanding their tasks, helping and motivating them. Managing resources means obtaining and allocating people, money, equipment, supplies and space. Showing technical competence means understanding the specialised work, as an orchestra conductor understands instruments and composition.
行政管理技能
管理人员需要与员工保持联系、了解他们的任务，并提供帮助和激励。管理资源包括获取和分配人力、经费、设备、物资与空间。具备技术胜任力意味着理解专业工作，例如乐团指挥懂得乐器与作曲。
Interpersonal skills

Being socially perceptive means understanding people’s priorities, concerns and likely reactions to change. Showing emotional intelligence means recognising your emotions and their causes, understanding others’ feelings and regulating your response. Managing interpersonal conflict involves addressing substantive issues about the work and relational issues such as control or respect.
人际技能
社会感知是理解他人的优先事项、顾虑和对变化可能产生的反应。情绪智力包括识别自己的情绪及其原因、理解他人的感受，并调节自己的反应。管理人际冲突既要处理工作内容上的分歧，也要处理控制权、尊重等关系问题。
Conceptual skills

Problem solving addresses obstacles systematically. Strategic planning sets longer-term priorities and considers how to achieve them. Creating visions means describing a desirable future and modelling the values that support it.
概念技能
解决问题是有步骤地排除障碍。战略规划是确定长期重点，思考如何实现目标。建立愿景是描绘值得追求的未来，并以行动体现支撑愿景的价值观。
Four steps in problem solving

1. Identify the problem and its causes.  2. Generate alternative solutions.  3. Select the best solution by considering cost, feasibility and trade-offs.  4. Implement the solution and communicate the change to those affected.
解决问题的四个步骤
① 明确问题及原因。② 提出多个可行方案。③ 权衡成本、可行性和取舍，选出最佳方案。④ 落实方案，并向受变化影响的人说明情况。
Distinguishing the evidence

Anticipating resistance to a new schedule shows social perceptiveness. Noticing your own frustration and calming down before listening shows emotional intelligence. Reallocating staff to cover an understaffed shift shows resource management.
从行为判断技能
预见员工会抵触新排班，体现社会感知。觉察到自己的挫败感、先平复情绪再倾听，体现情绪智力。调配人员填补班次缺口，体现资源管理。

lessons.title: Paper Tower Challenge
sections: Paper Tower Challenge

Observe how leaders emerge under time and resource constraints. Use a specific action as evidence for a trait or skill. A change in design can illustrate how a group generates, evaluates and implements a solution.
纸塔团队挑战
观察在时间和材料有限时，团队的领导者是怎样出现的。用一个具体行动说明某项特质或技能。团队调整塔的设计，可以展示大家怎样提出、评估并落实方案。

lessons.title: Sweet Caroline’s
sections: Sweet Caroline’s

Caroline built customer loyalty through baking expertise and personal relationships. Growth exposed problems in delivery tracking, staff scheduling and delegation. Look for evidence of each skill in a concrete business decision.
卡罗琳的烘焙坊
卡罗琳凭借烘焙专长和良好的顾客关系建立了顾客忠诚度。业务扩大后，配送追踪、员工排班和授权分工都出现了问题。判断技能时，要从具体经营决策中寻找证据。
Conceptual skills

Problem solving addresses obstacles systematically. Strategic planning sets longer-term priorities and considers how to achieve them. Creating visions means describing a desirable future and modelling the values that support it.
概念技能
解决问题是有步骤地排除障碍。战略规划是确定长期重点，思考如何实现目标。建立愿景是描绘值得追求的未来，并以行动体现支撑愿景的价值观。

lessons.title: Task and relationship leadership
sections: Task-oriented behaviour · initiating structure

A leader organises work, defines responsibilities, sets deadlines and schedules activities to help a group reach its goal. A written checklist or a clear division of responsibilities provides structure.
任务导向行为：建立工作结构
领导者通过组织工作、划分职责、规定期限和安排活动来帮助群体实现目标。书面检查清单或清楚的分工，都能为成员提供工作结构。
Relationship-oriented behaviour · consideration
A leader builds trust, respect and camaraderie, listens to people and pays attention to their individual needs. Inviting quieter team members to contribute gives them a voice in decisions.
关系导向行为：关怀成员
领导者建立信任、尊重与伙伴关系，倾听成员意见并关注个人需求。邀请较少发言的人参与讨论，让他们也能影响团队决策。
Everyday orientation

Task-oriented people often use plans and to-do lists and find satisfaction in completing things. Relationship-oriented people value connection and pay attention to what others are experiencing in the moment. Most leaders blend both orientations.
日常行为倾向
任务导向的人常使用计划和待办清单，并从完成任务中获得满足。关系导向的人看重联结，关注别人此刻的感受。大多数领导者兼具这两种倾向。
Matching the situation

A new team may need more direction because its members do not yet know their roles. An experienced team may value autonomy. Effective leaders adjust the balance of direction and support while attending to both the task and the people doing it.
根据情境调整
新团队的成员可能尚不熟悉职责，因此需要更明确的指导。经验丰富的团队可能更看重自主权。有效的领导者既关注任务也关注执行者，并据此调整指导与支持的比例。
lessons.headingZh: 任务与关系导向的领导

lessons.title: Task and relationship cases
sections: Co-Ed Cleaners · Dan and Asher

Dan relies on checklists and close supervision. Asher works alongside employees and gives them autonomy. Dan’s former staff may feel uncertain under Asher; Asher’s former staff may feel mistrusted under Dan. A manager taking over both teams needs to adapt to their different expectations.
洗衣店案例：丹与阿舍
丹依靠清单和密切监督，阿舍则与员工并肩工作并让他们自主安排任务。丹原来的员工在阿舍手下可能无所适从；阿舍原来的员工在丹手下可能感到不受信任。接手两组员工的经理需要适应两组不同的期待。

lessons.title: Martin Seligman interview
sections: Strengths and positive psychology

A strength is a quality that helps a person perform at their best. Positive psychology, associated with Martin Seligman, studies what helps people flourish, including engagement, meaning, positive relationships and accomplishment. Recognising strengths allows leaders to develop their own potential and draw out others’ abilities.
优势与积极心理学
优势是帮助个人发挥最佳水平的品质。塞利格曼等人研究的积极心理学关注什么能促使人蓬勃发展，包括投入感、意义感、积极关系和成就。识别优势可以帮助领导者发展自己的潜力，也能发掘成员的能力。
Gallup · Talent × Investment = Strength

Talent is a recurring natural pattern of thought, feeling or behaviour. Investment means time spent practising, gaining knowledge and developing skills. Gallup groups 34 talent themes into four domains: executing, influencing, relationship building and strategic thinking.
盖洛普：天赋 × 投入 = 优势
天赋是反复出现的自然思维、感受或行为模式。投入是花时间练习、学习知识和培养技能。盖洛普把 34 种天赋主题归入执行、影响、建立关系和战略思维四个领域。
VIA · Values in Action

Seligman and Peterson organised 24 character strengths under six virtues: wisdom and knowledge, courage, humanity, justice, temperance and transcendence. VIA focuses on character. Gallup emphasises talent and performance, particularly in the workplace. CAPP adds energy and frequency of use.
VIA：行动中的价值观
塞利格曼和彼得森把 24 项性格优势归入六类美德：智慧与知识、勇气、仁爱、公正、节制和超越。VIA 关注性格，盖洛普关注天赋和表现，尤其是职场表现。CAPP 还考虑做一件事时的精力感受和使用频率。
Complementary strengths

A leader can build a well-rounded team by combining people with different strengths. In the bridal-shop example, Maria recognises her own strengths and hires colleagues whose strengths complement hers.
优势互补
领导者可以让各有所长的人共同组成能力全面的团队。在婚纱店案例中，玛丽亚先了解自己的长处，再聘用能与她形成互补的同事。

lessons.title: Co-Ed Cleaners reflection
sections: Narrative and parenthetical citations

A narrative citation makes the author part of the sentence: “Northouse (2018) describes leadership as an influence process.” A parenthetical citation places the source after the idea: “Leadership involves influencing a group towards a common goal (Northouse, 2018).” Paraphrase the idea in your own words and keep the citation.
叙述式引用与括号式引用
叙述式引用把作者写进句子，如“Northouse（2018）将领导力描述为一种影响过程”。括号式引用把来源放在观点之后，如“领导力涉及影响群体以实现共同目标（Northouse, 2018）”。即使用自己的话转述，也要保留引用。
Bibliography

List the full details needed to locate each cited source. Match the author and year in the text to the corresponding entry. For a book, include the author, year, title and publisher, plus edition information when relevant. Arrange entries alphabetically by author or organisation. Use the publication details of the source you actually consulted.
参考书目
列出足以让读者找到每项来源的信息。正文的作者和年份应与书目对应。图书条目包括作者、年份、书名和出版社，必要时还需列出版本。按作者或机构名称的字母顺序排列，并使用自己实际查阅版本的出版信息。
Photographs and online images

Course template: Photographer’s name (Year). Title of photograph. Available at: URL (Accessed: date). Italicise the photograph title. Identify the creator and actual source. The course uses Pixabay to illustrate finding images and giving credit.
照片与网络图片
课程模板依次列出摄影者姓名、年份、照片标题、网址和访问日期。照片标题使用斜体，并注明创作者和实际来源。课程用 Pixabay 示范如何查找图片和署名。
AI-generated images

Place a short note below the image: “Note. Image generated with [AI tool] ([Company], [Year]).” If you modified it, add “Edited by the author.” Image notes identify the specific visual, while bibliography entries help readers locate a source.
AI 生成图片
在图片下方用简短说明列出生成工具、公司和年份。如果自己编辑过图片，再注明“Edited by the author”。图下注释标明该图的来源，书目提供查找来源所需的信息。
Reflection structure in the Lesson 15 example

Opening gives the judgement and main reason. What? gives concrete evidence. So what? explains why it matters for leadership. Now what? gives an implication or future action. The Co-Ed Cleaners example connects Dan’s and Asher’s behaviours to what their teams need.
第 15 课的反思结构
开头说明判断和主要理由。“发生了什么”给出具体证据；“这有何意义”解释证据与领导力的关系；“接下来怎么办”指出启示或未来行动。洗衣店示例把两位经理的行为与各自团队的需求联系起来。

lessons.title: Strengths reflection
sections: VIA · Values in Action

Seligman and Peterson organised 24 character strengths under six virtues: wisdom and knowledge, courage, humanity, justice, temperance and transcendence. VIA focuses on character. Gallup emphasises talent and performance, particularly in the workplace. CAPP adds energy and frequency of use.
VIA：行动中的价值观
塞利格曼和彼得森把 24 项性格优势归入六类美德：智慧与知识、勇气、仁爱、公正、节制和超越。VIA 关注性格，盖洛普关注天赋和表现，尤其是职场表现。CAPP 还考虑做一件事时的精力感受和使用频率。
Performance · energy · use

Performance means how well you perform the activity. Energy means how energised or drained you feel when doing it. Use means how often you do it. CAPP treats strengths as dynamic: circumstances and experience can change how a person uses them.
表现、能量与使用频率
表现指做得有多好；能量指做这件事时感到振奋还是疲惫；使用频率指多久做一次。CAPP 把优势看成可以变化的：处境和经历都会影响一个人发挥优势的方式。
Realised strength · maximise
You perform well, feel energised and use the strength regularly. You explain ideas clearly, enjoy it and regularly explain difficult points to teammates.
已发挥的优势：充分运用
你做得好，做的时候有精神，也经常用到这项优势。例如你讲解得清楚，很享受讲解，平时也经常帮队友讲难点。
Unrealised strength · marshal
You perform well and feel energised, but rarely use the strength. When you get a rare opportunity to explain an idea, you do it well and enjoy it. Seek more opportunities to use this strength.
尚未充分发挥的优势：创造机会
你做得好，也从中得到能量，只是很少有机会使用。例如偶尔轮到你讲解时，你能讲清楚并乐在其中。可以主动寻找更多发挥机会。
Learned behaviour · moderate
You have learned to perform well, but the activity gives you little energy or drains you. Practice has made you a capable speaker, but each explanation leaves you tired. Use this behaviour as needed.
习得行为：适度使用
你通过练习学会把事情做好，但做起来得不到多少能量，甚至感到疲惫。例如你靠训练掌握了讲解技巧，每次讲解却很耗神，可以按需要适度使用。
Weakness · minimise
You find the activity difficult, perform poorly and feel drained. You struggle to explain the idea, and your listeners still do not understand it. Sharing the task can reduce the impact on the team.
弱点：减少影响
你觉得这件事困难，表现不佳，做起来也耗费精力。例如讲解时很吃力，听众仍没有听懂。可以通过调整分工来减少影响。
A complete English explanation

Scheduling is a learned behaviour for this student because the student consistently produces accurate schedules but finds the work draining. Check performance and energy first. Then use frequency to distinguish realised from unrealised strengths.
完整英文解释示例
排期是这名学生的习得行为，因为他总能准确排好日程，却觉得这项工作很耗精力。判断时先看表现，再看能量；区分两种优势时，还要看使用频率。

lessons.title: PowerPoint design and images
sections: Slide design

Apply the course’s 666 rule: six lines of key words, six words per line, and a font size of 16–32 points. Give each slide one main idea. A useful sequence is to name it, define it and give an example. Choose an image that helps the audience understand the point.
幻灯片设计
按本课的 666 规则，每页约六行关键词，每行约六个词，字号为 16–32 磅。一页围绕一个主旨，可以先说出概念，再下定义，然后举例。选择能帮助听众理解该要点的图片。
Photographs and online images

Course template: Photographer’s name (Year). Title of photograph. Available at: URL (Accessed: date). Italicise the photograph title. Identify the creator and actual source. The course uses Pixabay to illustrate finding images and giving credit.
照片与网络图片
课程模板依次列出摄影者姓名、年份、照片标题、网址和访问日期。照片标题使用斜体，并注明创作者和实际来源。课程用 Pixabay 示范如何查找图片和署名。
AI-generated images

Place a short note below the image: “Note. Image generated with [AI tool] ([Company], [Year]).” If you modified it, add “Edited by the author.” Image notes identify the specific visual, while bibliography entries help readers locate a source.
AI 生成图片
在图片下方用简短说明列出生成工具、公司和年份。如果自己编辑过图片，再注明“Edited by the author”。图下注释标明该图的来源，书目提供查找来源所需的信息。

lessons.title: Steve Jobs and strengths
sections: Complementary strengths

A leader can build a well-rounded team by combining people with different strengths. In the bridal-shop example, Maria recognises her own strengths and hires colleagues whose strengths complement hers.
优势互补
领导者可以让各有所长的人共同组成能力全面的团队。在婚纱店案例中，玛丽亚先了解自己的长处，再聘用能与她形成互补的同事。
Managing weaknesses and the team environment

Lisa understood the technical work but struggled to explain it to clients. She hired a marketing consultant and observed how to communicate more clearly. Steve Jobs combined product focus and simplicity with weaknesses in technical and interpersonal areas. Leaders cultivate a strengths-based environment through positive climate, positive relationships, positive communication and meaningful work.
应对弱点与营造团队环境
莉萨精通技术，却难以向客户解释工作。她聘请营销顾问，通过观察学习怎样说得更清楚。乔布斯专注产品、追求简洁，同时在技术和人际层面存在弱点。积极的氛围、人际关系、沟通方式和有意义的工作，都有助于成员发挥优势。
Jobs: resilience and vision

After leaving Apple, Jobs founded NeXT. Its hardware struggled commercially, but its software later contributed to Apple products. In the Macintosh example, Jobs used a concrete product to help people see his vision of personal computing.
乔布斯：韧性与愿景
离开苹果后，乔布斯创办了 NeXT。它的硬件在市场上遇到困难，但软件后来为苹果产品提供了技术基础。在麦金塔电脑的案例中，乔布斯用具体的产品向人们展示他对个人计算的愿景。

lessons.title: Question time
sections: Introduction and hook

Greet the audience and introduce the team. State the topic, outline the sections and speakers, give the duration, explain when questions will be taken, and introduce the first section. For an online talk, establish credibility by saying what you know about the topic. A hook gives the audience a reason to listen.
开场与引起兴趣
问候听众，介绍团队和主题，说明各部分及讲者、总时长和提问时间，然后引入第一部分。线上演讲可以通过解释自己对主题的了解来建立可信度。好的开场会给听众一个继续听下去的理由。
Linking and handover
Signal what you have finished and introduce the next speaker and topic. Example: “That covers the main leadership traits. Mei will now explain how these traits appear in our case.”
衔接与交接
先说明刚刚讲完的内容，再介绍下一位讲者和主题。例如：“以上是主要领导特质。接下来梅将解释这些特质怎样体现在我们的案例中。”
Summary and conclusion

A summary restates the main ideas. A conclusion gives the final message or recommendation. “We examined three ways to identify strengths” summarises content. “We recommend assigning roles according to complementary strengths” gives a conclusion.
总结与结论
总结重述主要内容，结论提出最终判断或建议。“我们介绍了三种识别优势的方法”是总结；“我们建议依据优势互补来分配团队角色”是结论。
Delivery and questions

For recorded slides, pause during slide transitions because speech may not be recorded. At question time, invite participation, clarify ambiguous questions and acknowledge limits to the evidence. “Could you give an example?” requests clarification. “We don’t have enough evidence to show that” addresses a difficult question.
表达与问答
录制幻灯片时，在换页过程中暂停说话，因为过渡期间可能录不到声音。问答时邀请听众参与，澄清含糊的问题，并坦诚说明证据的局限。“能举个例子吗”用于澄清，“目前证据不足以证明这一点”可用来回应难题。
